player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long wanpela {max_rounds} raun gem bilong Kuhn Poker.
Ol Rul bilong Gem:
- Kuhn Poker i usim wanpela dek kadi 3 wantaim J, Q, K (J i stap daunbilo, K i stap antap)
- Olgeta player i mas givim {ante} chip na kisim wanpela kadi long olgeta raun (tingim olsem kadi i givim nating, na yu no inap kisim wanpela kadi wankain olsem bilong yu)
- Gem i go i go inap long {max_rounds} raun
- Player i gat planti chip long olgeta raun bai i win
Ol Rul bilong Aksan:
- '[check]': Pas nating (tasol sapos nogat bet i stap long tebol)
- '[bet]': Putim 1 chip long pot (tasol sapos nogat bet i stap long tebol)
- '[call]': Kolim bet bilong arapela player long putim 1 chip long pot
- '[fold]': Sori long han yu na larim arapela player i winim pot

outcome.draw: Long pinis bilong {max_rounds} raun, tupela man i gat wankain namba long ol chip.
